generatedProse.practice-connection:
This course is about a kind of learning you will meet again and again across your degree. Many modules build in placements, fieldwork, practical sessions or projects set with a real brief, and they ask you to learn by taking part, not only by reading. Treat what follows as being about your own placements and projects, not about study in the abstract.

The same idea runs through working life. Wherever you take on real tasks, watch how skilled people work, and learn from doing, you are learning the way this course describes. The habit of treating real work as a chance to learn is one you will keep long after you graduate.
